portal_hypertension.title: Transnasal endoscopy as a complementary tool for ambulatory detection of clinically significant portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.authors: Cortez-Hernández CA, González-Torres LA, Jiménez-Castillo RA
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：评估了经鼻内窥镜检查的有效性、安全性和耐受性，作为一种补充工具，用于检测与代偿性晚期慢性肝病成人门静脉高压一致的内镜症状。 临床提示：24 名患者在局部麻醉下接受了经鼻上消化道内窥镜检查，并通过弹性成像和血小板计数对肝纤维化进行无创评估。
portal_hypertension.abstract: The efficacy, safety, and tolerability of transnasal endoscopy were evaluated as a complementary tool for detecting endoscopic signs consistent with portal hypertension in adults with compensated advanced chronic liver disease. Twenty-four patients underwent transnasal upper gastrointestinal endoscopy under local anesthesia and noninvasive assessment of liver fibrosis through elastography and platelet count. Procedure-related pain intensity and anxiety, adverse events, and impact on therapeutic decision-making were analyzed. The procedure was well tolerated, with no adverse events, and periprocedural discomfort and anxiety were minimal-to-mild. Transnasal endoscopy modified therapeutic decis...

portal_hypertension.title: Spleen stiffness to rule out high-risk varices in advanced chronic liver disease: an individual patient data meta-analysis.
portal_hypertension.authors: Dajti E, Qi X, Chen J
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们进行了个体患者数据（IPD）荟萃分析，以（i）使用振动控制瞬态弹性成像（VCTE）研究基于脾硬度测量（SSM）的算法的性能，以排除高风险静脉曲张（HRV）； (ii) 制定一个 临床提示：食管静脉曲张（EV）的治疗对于代偿性晚期慢性肝病至关重要。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Management of esophageal varices (EV) is of critical importance in compensated advanced chronic liver disease. We conducted an individual patient data (IPD) meta-analysis to (i) investigate the performance of spleen stiffness measurement (SSM)-based algorithms using vibration-controlled transient elastography (VCTE) to rule out high-risk varices (HRV); (ii) develop a new model for diagnosing any grade EV. We systematically searched databases for studies reporting endoscopy and SSM-VCTE data in adult patients, collecting their IPD. The main outcome was ruling out HRV. portal_hypertension.title: A real-world multicenter study of statins in compensated advanced chronic liver disease on hepatic decompensation and mortality outcomes.
portal_hypertension.authors: Ng CH, Sasikumar NA, Teng MLP
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：他汀类药物具有多效作用，包括抗炎、内皮和抗纤维化作用，可能会减缓肝硬化的进展。 临床提示：然而，由于担心潜在的肝毒性，它们在代偿性晚期慢性肝病 (cACLD) 患者中的使用仍然有限，并且针对该人群的数据仍然很少。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Statins exert pleiotropic effects, including antiinflammatory, endothelial, and antifibrotic actions, which may slow the progression of cirrhosis. However, their use in patients with compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD) remains limited due to concerns regarding potential hepatotoxicity, and data specific to this population remains sparse. We conducted a retrospective, multinational cohort study of adult cACLD (LSM >10 kPa) patients using data from the Cirrhosis Outcome and Research Endeavor (CORE) consortium, across 13 centers in 8 countries. portal_hypertension.title: Nonselective beta-blockers and hepatic encephalopathy in liver cirrhosis:A meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
portal_hypertension.journal: Journal of the Chinese Medical Association : JCMA
portal_hypertension.authors: Kuo TH, Chen YJ, Lee PC
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：肝硬化会导致门脉高压和相关并发症，包括腹水、食管静脉曲张和肝性脑病（HE）。 临床提示：因此，我们在涉及肝硬化患者的随机对照试验 (RCT) 中研究了 NSBB 治疗与 HE 之间的关联。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver cirrhosis leads to portal hypertension and related complications, including ascites, esophageal varices, and hepatic encephalopathy (HE). Non-selective beta blockers (NSBBs) decrease portal pressure, but it is not yet clear whether they contribute to HE development. Therefore, we examined the association between NSBB therapy and HE in randomized controlled trials (RCTs) involving patients with cirrhosis. We systematically searched PubMed, Web of Science, ScienceDirect, and the Cochrane Library (from inception to December 31, 2024) for RCTs comparing NSBBs with a placebo, endoscopic band ligation, or injection sclerotherapy for variceal bleeding prevention in relation to HE.
